entries.title: Dunne Regio
entries.extract: Dunne Regio is a regio on 951 Gaspra, an asteroid. The regio was named after Dr. James A. Dunne, an eponymous planner of the Galileo project. The name "Dunne Regio" was officially approved by the International Astronomical Union (IAU) in 1994.
